grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 44721 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so every row is a distinct, non-duplicated event; invoice_id alone has only 2330 distinct values against 44721 rows, showing each invoice spans many lines, so the line-level identity is the invoice_id plus stock_code pair, which the derived identifier hashes; with zero duplicate rows this tuple is not expected to collide, so no aggregation is needed to absorb duplicates.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice number such as 489434-489443 in the samples, zero null_rate, used with stock_code to identify the transaction line rather than measured.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Boolean flag with distinct_values [false, true] and zero null_rate marking whether the line represents a cancelled order, a classifying attribute not a measure.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product/stock code such as 10002, 10080 in the samples, zero null_rate, identifies the product on the line and combines with invoice_id for line identity.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product description (e.g. '12 PENCIL SMALL TUBE WOODLAND'); null_rate 0.005098 so it is nullable, likely due to unmatched or discontinued stock codes.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Integer quantity ranging from -1395 to 5184 with zero null_rate; negative values align with the is_cancellation flag, and the column is summed/compared across lines, making it a measure.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp ranging 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00 with zero null_rate; all sampled values fall exactly on minute boundaries (seconds always :00), so the finest resolvable grain is minute.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Decimal unit price ranging 0.0 to 1998.49 with zero null_rate, a numeric amount compared and aggregated across lines, making it a measure.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Integer customer identifier ranging 12346 to 18287; null_rate 0.300664 so it is nullable, likely representing guest or unidentified-customer transactions; it labels the customer rather than measuring anything, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer country such as Australia, Austria, Belgium in the samples (24 distinct values), zero null_rate, a classifying attribute of the line.

category_description: One row represents a single invoice line item: a specific product and quantity sold (or cancelled) on a given invoice at a given minute, for a given customer and country.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, specifying its time column, grain, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models from this contract.
usage: The rendered mapping contract is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted with datacontract lint, and reviewed by a human before approval; once approved, the deterministic modeling engine reads it to generate the gold fact and its degenerate line identity, with no manual table creation involved.
limitations: The mapping does not resolve the 30.1% null_rate on customer_id into a known-customer flag, does not interpret negative quantity values beyond noting their correlation with is_cancellation, and leaves any filtering of cancelled lines or null-description lines to downstream consumers of the generated gold model.
